decision: A fixed board whose squares never move is one dense array in a resource, not one entity per square. Entities stay for things that keep their identity as they move, or appear and clear. AGENTS.md rule 2, the ecs and systems recipes, the plugin.ts header, the sim README, state-architecture.md and ecs-patterns.md now say so.
why: The blanket rule had agents model every square of a turn-based lattice as an entity, for no gain. Porting a shipped constraint-grid core (sudoku, word sudoku, queens) to one Cell archetype grew the core by a third, raised a write from 14.35 to 29.26 microseconds, made every consumer of the board change, and still did not let the shared piece view draw the grid (five features missing).
